**Speed** 20 feet, fly 15 feet

<actions string="Single Action" />
_scimitar_ +17 ([forceful +1](/Traits.aspx?ID=75), [Sweep](/Traits.aspx?ID=194)),
**Damage** 2d6+12 slashing

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
fist +16 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [Nonlethal](/Traits.aspx?ID=188)),
**Damage** 1d4+12 bludgeoning

**Ranged**
<actions string="Single Action" />
composite shortbow +15 ([deadly d10](/Traits.aspx?ID=174), [Propulsive](/Traits.aspx?ID=191), [range increment 60 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248), [reload 0](/Traits.aspx?ID=254)),
**Damage** 1d6+7 piercing

**Arcane Innate Spells** DC 24
- **1st**
[Create Water](/Spells.aspx?ID=53)
- **2nd**
[Create Food](/Spells.aspx?ID=52), [Invisibility](/Spells.aspx?ID=164) (×3), [Speak with Animals](/Spells.aspx?ID=293)
- **7th**
[Plane Shift](/Spells.aspx?ID=222) (to [Astral Plane](/Planes.aspx?ID=8), Elemental Planes, or [Material Plane](/Planes.aspx?ID=1) only)

**Change Size**  ([Arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11), [Concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [Polymorph](/Traits.aspx?ID=127), [Transmutation](/Traits.aspx?ID=157)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** The janni changes a creature's size. This works as a 4th-level [_enlarge_](/Spells.aspx?ID=102) or [_shrink_](/Spells.aspx?ID=284) spell but can target an unwilling creature (DC 24 Fortitude save negates).

</column>
